authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

audit_focus.card: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen
graph_refs: graph:data/grixis/graph/edea-possessed-sorceress.json#metrics/Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

value: Don't drift into a generic aristocrats deck that only sacrifices its own creatures (source).
No compact cEDH combo package; the source sets a commander-first B4 shell.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Creature-light opponents leave nothing worth stealing.
Five-mana commander removed: theft and draw stop.
Returning the creature gives its owner its enter triggers again.

value.interaction: Counters (Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Swan Song, Arcane Denial) and resets (Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act).
value.mana: Five-mana commander: Sol Ring, Ancient Tomb, Talismans, Arcane Signet.
value.protection: Ward {2}, Lightning Greaves, Deflecting Swat, Fierce Guardianship.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Edea is the only repeatable source of free theft and the card-draw half of every sacrifice.
accepted_role.honest_note: She steals at beginning of combat on your turn only, needs a worthwhile target on an opposing board, and her draw clause needs the borrowed creature to die while you control it. Against creature-light tables the engine is weak.

reviews.question: Can the deck rebuild after repeated removal across multiple permanent types?

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume combat or targeting is materially constrained. Identify noncombat pivots, answers, and any commander-native route that still functions.
